title: Domain Intelligence
tagline: Every website on the internet starts with an address. Behind that address is an ownership trail that any professional knows how to read.
description: Go deep on the first technical OSINT skill in every professional reconnaissance engagement: domain intelligence. Learn what domains, IP addresses, and DNS really are — from scratch. Understand WHOIS, registrars, registries, TLDs, DNS record types, and ASNs. By the end, you can read any organisation's complete internet infrastructure from public records alone.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Define what a domain is and explain the difference between a domain and a website
Explain what an IP address is and describe how it relates to domain names
Describe how DNS resolution works in plain language
Identify the five key DNS record types and what each one reveals about an organisation's infrastructure
Explain WHOIS, registrar, registry, and TLD — and what each one tells an investigator
Define ASN and explain why knowing an organisation's ASN reveals their complete IP range
skills: Reading WHOIS records to extract registrar, registration date, nameservers, and registrant data
Querying all DNS record types to map mail infrastructure, cloud providers, CDN usage, and SaaS relationships
Using ASN data to discover the full IP range of a target's internet-facing infrastructure
